note: Majority: Civil Code of the Republic of Moldova No. 1107 of 6 June 2002 (as amended up to Law No. 211 of 29 July 2016, the text WIPO Lex holds), Article 20: full capacity to act begins when a person becomes of age, at 18; a minor gains it by marriage, and one of 16 may be recognised as fully capable if working under an employment contract or, with parents' consent, in business (not held). The Code was substantially amended by Law No. 133/2018; whether Article 20 changed wasn't read. Work and service: not read. The Labour Code and the law on military service are published on legis.md, which answers behind a Cloudflare challenge ('Just a moment'), not passed; the Ministry of Defence's site (army.md) gave no page on conscription in its menus or sitemap, and archive.org couldn't be reached.

sources.title: WIPO Lex, Codul civil al Republicii Moldova nr. 1107 din 06.06.2002 (amended up to Law No. 211 of 29.07.2016)
sources.said: Articolul 20. Capacitatea deplină de exerciţiu a persoanei fizice (1) Capacitatea deplină de exerciţiu începe la data cînd persoana fizică devine majoră, adică la împlinirea vîrstei de 18 ani.
